rationale: The 8.8 aggregate Premier Triage and Response row lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR; the detailed Cloud task requires Platform 10.2+, ES 8.7+, the enabled assistant and paired SOAR. The detailed task uses existing triaged findings and qualifies first-ten burst and about 200 daily tenant limits, frontier models and connector/action/asset permissions. The 8.7 task retains the older AI SOC Analyst wording. Both the mapped detailed task and the current explicitly titled Triage and Response task list Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect app 2.0 for Cloud Connected customer-managed deployment. The standalone setup URL returned HTTP 404; its index result was excluded from assessment. The current release page states November 4 General Availability; its mapped historical Controlled Availability section is unavailable. The edition, Cloud Connect and SAIA region tables provide their own scoped context. Exact SOAR pairing, agent-specific regional rollout, entitlement and customer authorization are excluded from this decision.

exclusions: CMP has its separate Platform 10.4+/ES 8.8+/Cloud Connect 2.0 chain; no lower-floor eligibility, tenant rollout, entitlement, pairing or authorization is established.
